protocol.historical_availability: ASSUMED; not measured original candle receipt
protocol.target: OHLC of next full calendar minute after snapshot; reject results ready at or after target start
protocol.preprocessing: fit-only input scalers; fit-only target scales; no dropping/joining context gaps
protocol.label_units: OHLC basis-point returns relative to final input candle close

mlp.input: flatten all 1440x8 candle and 60x(87+5) book/trade features

protocol.output: four OHLC values; open/close plus softplus high/low excursions ensuring valid candles

training.loss: mean squared error of fit-standardized OHLC returns
training.device: MPS if supported, otherwise CPU; record actual device and determinism limits

selection.architecture: lowest three-seed mean development OHLC MAE; tie within 0.01 bp favors smaller parameter count

uncertainty.calibration: For each OHLC output, symmetric residual interval around point prediction. Calibration absolute error rank min(n,ceil((n+1)*coverage)) at coverage 0.80 and 0.95; per-output marginal intervals, no joint/IID/time-series guarantee.
uncertainty.note: Temporal dependence and two calibration days prevent an IID coverage guarantee

protocol.test_access: No model test scores until architectures/checkpoints and calibration fixed. Never tune from test. Baselines now score development only.
protocol.timing_sensitivity: Predeclared phases 0/15/30/45 and grace 1/5/30/60 seconds; compare common targets; no hyperparameter retuning per scenario

error_views.recent_market: only prospectively recorded predictions after targets mature; presently unavailable

protocol.reporting: Publish failed runs, all seeds, actual epochs, hashes, parameters/device/cost. A pilot need not prove profitability; claim no live advantage without forward outcomes.
